validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/DUPLICATE/CLASSIFICATION checked first, per priority order. (1) The gem.wiki page's own 53-item reference list was read in full for leads (never cited): NOT ONE citation on the page mentions Liuzhou/Liudong/Luonan/Liunan (checked for every variant: 柳州, 柳南, 罗村, 柳东) — the page's citations are almost all for OTHER segments sharing this same wiki article (南宁-凭祥, 桂林-灵川-兴安, 河池-南丹, 来宾-武宣-象州-金秀, 梧州-峑溪, 南宁-崇左, etc.). A row whose only wiki support is a generic aggregate page that never names it is an existence flag by the brief's own rule, so I went straight to independent open-web search. (2) Found a Tier-1 independent confirmation: the PRC National Development and Reform Commission's official Dec-2023 cross-provincial gas pipeline tariff table (ndrc.gov.cn PDF, read directly — not via the lossy substring extractor) lists as its own line item #15: '广西LNG外输管线' (Guangxi LNG External Transmission Pipeline), start 广西北海 (Beihai), end 广西柳州 (Liuzhou), with named branches '柳东支线、粤西支线、桂林支线' (Liudong Branch, Yuexi/West-Guangdong Branch, Guilin Branch). '柳东支线' = Liudong Branch is an EXACT structural match to P4718's route (Liuzhou Transmission Station → Liudong Transmission Station) — this is real, officially tariffed infrastructure, not a phantom. (3) Second independent source: a Guangxi-bureau chinanews.com.cn article (2022-08-03, verified live + content-checked with a corrected UTF-8 decode after the verifier's default encoding auto-detect mis-flagged it as ISO-8859-1 — the raw bytes do contain 广西天然气管道有限责任公司, 柳州, 柳州东城燃气, 柳州中燃) confirms this same operator company actively supplies downstream Liuzhou gas retailers, and states the whole '广西LNG管道' network is now 735km through 7 cities. (4) DUPLICATE check against the roster: P4719 shares the identical start point (Liuzhou Transmission Station, Luoman Town, Liunan District) but is 155.7km/813mm vs P4718's 29km/610mm, and is very likely the network's separate, larger '桂林支线' (Guilin Branch, per the same NDRC list — corroborated by a 14th-Five-Year-Plan item accelerating a 'Guangxi LNG external pipeline Guilin branch (Liuzhou–Guilin)') — a genuinely different, longer, larger-diameter line to a different destination than P4718's short local spur into Liudong New Area (柳东新区), a well-known development district inside Liuzhou city itself. Different NDRC-named branches, different endpoints, different diameters — not a double-count. (5) CLASSIFICATION: Fuel=Gas is correct; this is a genuine natural-gas transmission branch, not a gathering/feeder line. CAVEAT (SPEC): could not independently confirm the exact 29km length, 610mm diameter, or 2013 StartYear1 for this specific branch in any open source — a single weak trade-press source (shiyouyuzhuangbei.com, 2016) states that natural-gas branch pipeline construction in '柳州' (among several named cities) began in 2015, which chronologically could not precede a 2013 in-service date IF it refers to the same segment; however the sentence names Liuzhou only as one of several general-purpose branch projects and does not specify which route, so this may describe a different Liuzhou-area line entirely. Flagging rather than silently passing it, per the standing rule, but not escalating to a hard 'concern' given the single-source ambiguity.
